compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Daniel reads Jeremiah and confesses toward Jerusalem beside Remnant violence gives way to a lifted captive king; Songs stop by Babylon’s rivers; Cyrus authorizes return and rebuilding; The foundation joins shouting and weeping. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
